notes: Sourced from Ashly's official nXe Multi-Mode Amplifiers 2U spec sheet (DS-0716, ashly.com), which covers the nXe4004 alongside sibling models. No USB port exists on this model. Optional factory-installed digital-audio interface cards (Dante/OPDante, CobraNet/CNM-2 - both dual RJ45 - or AES3 XLR input cards) are separate purchased options, not included on the base nXe4004, so they are omitted from the port list; note them if the specific unit has one installed. The four per-channel Remote DC Level Control Euroblocks and the Stby/Preset/Fault control Euroblocks are grouped on the rear panel in shared multi-pin terminal blocks per the rear-panel diagram, but each is a distinct logical control signal. Ethernet grade listed as eth-100m per "Compatible w/ standard 100MB Ethernet" spec wording. Rack height is 2U per the 3.5in (89mm) panel height and product literature title ("nXe Multi-Mode Amplifiers 2U").

ports.name: Ch 2 Input
ports.note: Neutrik Combo XLR/TRS jack paired with a 3.5mm Euroblock terminal on the same channel input

ports.note: Neutrik Combo XLR/TRS jack paired with a 3.5mm Euroblock terminal on the same channel input

ports.name: Ch 4 Input
ports.note: Neutrik Combo XLR/TRS jack paired with a 3.5mm Euroblock terminal on the same channel input

ports.name: Aux Outputs
ports.note: Balanced Euroblock 3.5mm aux preamp line outputs for driving other amplifiers, +21dBu max level

ports.name: 10/100 Ethernet
ports.note: Control network port for Protea NE software control/monitoring; compatible with standard 100MB Ethernet

ports.name: Data
ports.note: Serial data port (Gnd, +18V, In, Out) for Ashly WR-5/RD-8C programmable remotes; optional INA-1 converter for third-party RS-232 control

ports.name: Stby/Fault (Low)
ports.note: Remote standby contact closure (close to GND for standby) combined with fault condition logic output on same rear-panel Euroblock group

ports.name: Preset
ports.note: Preset recall contact closure, close to GND for preset 1-4 recall

ports.name: Ch Remote DC Level
ports.note: Per-channel remote DC level control terminal (Gnd, CV, V+); present per channel (x4 total, one shown per channel pair on rear panel)

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: Neutrik powerCON detachable AC mains connector, 20A rating (32A powerCON only on the 3.04 model); auto-sensing 110-120VAC or 220-240VAC SMPS
